## Description

Size a bet based on estimated edge and payoff odds, commonly using a fractional Kelly coefficient to reduce estimation sensitivity.

## Where it may fit

Repeated bets with a credible estimate of return distribution and positive expected edge.

## Vehicles

Systematic trading books, sports-betting-style repeated-risk models, small strategy sleeves.

## Required data

Estimated mean/variance or win probability/payoff distribution, current capital, correlation among bets and hard risk limits.

## Caveats

Full Kelly is highly sensitive to estimation errors and can produce intolerable drawdowns; use conservative constraints.
